summary: Resumed from Phase 5 (the freeze lemma), which the prior dispatch left as an in-depth but unimplemented Investigation note. This dispatch independently re-derived the freeze mechanism from first principles (confirming the prior note's conclusion that the claim is true but genuinely large), then landed six new sorry-free, axiom-clean, purely additive Lean declarations across three files, committed as 4ffd1821: isRuleShape and intApplyRuleFull_notApplicable_iff (Rules.lean) give a bare, nw/b-independent characterization of when intApplyRuleFull is notApplicable; IFrozenBelow and intStepBranchPrioFirstPass_none_frozen (Expansion.lean) capture the checkpoint precondition -- every formula below a threshold w0 is world-creating, already expanded, or ruleless -- and derive it directly from intStepBranchPrioFirstPass returning none (the exact moment intStepBranchPrio falls through to world-creation); and in Scheme.lean, IWorldHist_isAccessible_lt (a new label-order corollary of the already-landed IWorldHist/IWorldHistCounter invariants, needing no new invariant threading) plus a five-lemma family culminating in IFrozenBelow_intStepBranchPrio_ge, which proves that a SINGLE intStepBranchPrio step, given IFrozenBelow w0 e b and w0 <= nw, can only write new content at labels >= w0. This is mechanism 3(a) of the freeze argument (the alpha/beta half), proved in full. Mechanism 3(b) (persistence-fixpoint preservation, needing IPosPersistRaw and the new label-order fact) is sketched with specific lemma names to reuse but not yet formalized, and the multi-step composition into intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's four-block induction -- needed to actually replace IReuseContain_mono, Phase 6's original mandate -- remains open. Both gaps are recorded precisely in the plan's new Progress note so the next dispatch starts from a concrete lemma inventory rather than re-deriving the mechanism a third time. Full lake build green at 3325 jobs (unchanged job count), lake test green at 9397 jobs with the 20-row conformance corpus verdict-unchanged, zero new sorries, zero new axioms.
